import re

def find_codes_in_text(text):
    if not text:
        return []
    s=text
    # Look specifically for promo code line formats
    patterns=[
        r'(?i)promo\s*code\s*=>\s*([A-Z0-9\-]{4,})',
        r'(?i)promo\s*code\s*[:\-]\s*([A-Z0-9\-]{4,})',
        r'(?i)coupon\s*code\s*=>\s*([A-Z0-9\-]{4,})',
        r'(?i)discount\s*code\s*=>\s*([A-Z0-9\-]{4,})',
        r'\b([A-Z]{2,}[A-Z0-9]{3,})\b'
    ]
    codes=[]
    for pat in patterns:
        for m in re.findall(pat, s):
            if m:
                codes.append(m)
    # Clean
    cleaned=[]
    seen=set()
    for c in codes:
        c=c.strip().upper()
        if len(c)<4: continue
        # require at least one digit
        if not re.search(r'\d', c):
            continue
        # exclude obvious words
        if c in {'PROMO','COUPON','DISCOUNT','AMAZON','OFFER'}:
            continue
        if c not in seen:
            seen.add(c); cleaned.append(c)
    return cleaned

    codes=find_codes_in_text(all_text)
